economy.summary: Her campaign says it will cut energy bills, reduce taxes, and support local businesses so families can keep more of what they earn; her platform also calls for improving pricing transparency to prevent unexpected cost increases and supporting job growth.
economy.short: Proposes cutting energy bills, supporting local businesses, pricing transparency.

taxes.summary: Her platform proposes reducing the tax burden on working families and small businesses and ensuring taxpayer dollars are used efficiently and responsibly.
taxes.short: Proposes reducing taxes on working families and small businesses.

education.summary: Her platform proposes supporting and retaining teachers by ensuring they have resources, empowering parents through better communication and transparency, expanding student opportunities including career pathways and life skills, and prioritizing student well-being including mental health and prevention-focused support.
education.short: Proposes supporting teachers, empowering parents, expanding career pathways.

energy.summary: Her platform calls for lowering energy and utility costs by addressing price drivers; it does not state a position on environmental policy.
energy.short: Proposes lowering energy costs; no environmental position stated.

economy.summary: His campaign says he helped pass Pennsylvania's Child & Dependent Care Tax Credit and Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit, and that he is pushing to raise the minimum wage on a path to $15, guarantee paid sick days for workers, and push back on tariff-driven price increases.
economy.short: Supports $15 minimum wage path, paid sick days, tax credits.

taxes.summary: Says he helped pass the Child & Dependent Care Tax Credit and the Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit, supports lowering property taxes by fully funding schools, and helped expand the Property Tax & Rent Rebate program for seniors.
taxes.short: Supports lowering property taxes via school funding; passed tax credits.

abortion.summary: His campaign says he will stand to keep reproductive decisions between a woman and her doctor, supports protecting the right to choose, and would block any abortion ban in Pennsylvania.
abortion.short: Supports abortion rights; would block any Pennsylvania abortion ban.

education.summary: Supports closing the court-ordered $4.5 billion school-funding adequacy gap, raising teacher pay, shrinking class sizes, and providing free breakfast and lunch for every student; says he helped secure record state funding for Parkland and Allentown schools.
education.short: Supports closing funding gap, raising teacher pay, free school meals.

healthcare.summary: Supports protecting Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act from cuts, saving rural hospitals, and lowering premiums and drug costs; co-founded the PA House Mental Health Caucus and says he led the push for new state mental-health funding.
healthcare.short: Supports protecting Medicaid and ACA; mental-health funding; lower costs.

energy.summary: Says he voted for six bills to regulate data centers and supports requiring data centers to bring their own power so energy costs are not passed to consumers, increasing the Public Utility Commission's regulatory authority, and letting local governments enact moratoriums; also calls for bringing down energy and utility bills.
energy.short: Supports data-center regulation; opposes passing energy costs to consumers.

guns.summary: Backs gun-safety bills that have passed the Pennsylvania House, including universal background checks, red-flag protections, a ban on untraceable ghost guns, and safe storage measures, while saying responsible gun owners can be respected.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks, red-flag protections, ghost-gun ban.
